name: espocrm-ext-inline-list-edit
description: Modification rapide des champs depuis les vues liste EspoCRM

scripts.integration-tests: export PATH="$PWD/docker-bin:$PATH"; node build --copy && node build --composer-install && cd site && php vendor/bin/phpunit tests/integration/Espo/Modules/InlineListEdit
scripts.sync: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint sh web -c 'chown -R 1000:33 /var/www/html/custom /var/www/html/client/custom && chmod -R a+rwX /var/www/html/custom /var/www/html/client/custom'; export PATH="$PWD/docker-bin:$PATH"; node build --copy && node build --composer-install

author: Alex Santin
